[USER] User expressed interest in understanding legal arguments and claims related to territorial disputes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an overview of legal arguments and claims made by countries involved in territorial disputes, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. South China Sea Dispute: China claims historical usage and sovereignty over the South China Sea, while the Philippines and Vietnam cite UNCLOS and an international tribunal ruling against China.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Israel-Palestine Dispute: Israel claims historic ties and legal rights based on the Balfour Declaration and UN Partition Plan, while Palestine cites illegal occupation and the Fourth Geneva Convention.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Kashmir Dispute: India claims Kashmir as an integral part of India based on historical accession, while Pakistan claims it should belong to Pakistan due to its Muslim majority.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant concluded that legal arguments depend on historical aspects, international laws, ethnic composition, and strategic interests.
